Some say you're wildly wealthy. Some say you're greedy, unprincipled, and dirty, that you do what you do for the pure joy of destroying so many well-laid plans. So tell me, Long Snoot. What are you really?''"
"''I am very far from home.|Kardue'sai'Malloc and Garindan ezz Zavor|audio=Labria-Zavor-FarFromHome-FACPOV.flac|}} '''Kardue'sai'Malloc''' was a wily [[Devaronian]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a cruel [[army]] [[captain]] on his [[homeworld]], [[Devaron]]. He later went into hiding under the alias '''Labria''' while on the run from his wicked past life, which had resulted in him having one of the largest [[Bounty|bounties]] in [[the galaxy]]. Pretending to be a major [[Information broker|informant]], Kardue'sai'Malloc spent much of his [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. In [[1 BBY]], he was present in the [[cantina]] when the [[Kubaz]] [[spy]] [[Garindan ezz Zavor]] entered seeking two [[droid]]s that the [[Galactic Empire]] was searching for and was later sharing a jigger of [[Merenzane Gold]] with two other patrons when the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] got into an altercation with the criminals [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]] at the establishment's bar. Zavor then asked Kardue'sai'Malloc to help him find work, and the Devaronian set him up with an [[assassin]]ation job with the [[Ketton]] [[Derrida]]. ==Biography== ===Cantina regular=== {{Quote|The band is good, eh?''"
"''Functional but lacking in higher tones.''"
"''You know nothing.|Kardue'sai'Malloc and Garindan ezz Zavor discuss Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes|audio=Labria-Zavor-GoodBand-FACPOV.flac|}} [[File:LabriaSabacc-BH.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Kardue'sai'Malloc, Nabrun Leids, and Muftak sit around a small table playing cards. Leids is looking toward the viewer and has a blaster pistol in hand under the table.|Kardue'sai'Malloc played sabacc with Nabrun Leids and Muftak.]] Kardue'sai'Malloc was a [[Devaronian]] [[Gender|male]] [[Homeworld|from]] the [[jungle]] [[planet]] [[Devaron]], where he served as an [[army]] [[captain]]. By [[1 BBY]],{{BountyHuntDate}} he was a war criminal{{EncyclopediaCite|Core Worlds, Colonies, the Inner Rim and Expansion Region}} on the run from a wicked past with one of [[the galaxy]]'s highest [[Bounty|bounties]] on his head for his deadly crimes. Using the assumed name Labria,''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' he hid in the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the planet [[Tatooine]], trying to pass himself off as a major [[Information broker|informant]] despite being a terrible [[spy]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], he spent much of his time in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] enjoying drinks with other unsavory locals.{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Labria|link=https://www.tcdb.com/viewcard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11689242/2018-topps-star-wars-galactic-files-anh-47-labria}} During that time period, he played a game of [[sabacc]] with the [[Morseerian]]''[[Bounty Hunt]]'' [[Nabrun Leids]]''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' and the [[Talz]] [[Muftak]] in one of the booths of the cantina while the [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk]] was seeking the rogue Imperial [[astromech droid]] [[261]] in the establishment. On a morning in 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Kardue'sai'Malloc was once again in the cantina and was hiding his pointy smile and tapping his fingers to [[music]] no one else could hear when the [[Kubaz]] informant [[Garindan ezz Zavor]] entered in search of two [[droid]]s that the Empire was looking for. After Zavor left to continue his search elsewhere, the Devaronian met with the [[Pacithhip]] [[Ketwol]]{{SWCT|set=Alien Underground|cardname=Ketwol}} and the [[Defel]] [[Arleil Schous]]''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' in the cantina. The group shared a jigger of [[Merenzane Gold]], an [[alcohol]]ic beverage, at a table next to the [[Lamproid]] [[Dice Ibegon]]{{ForceCollection|Lak Sivrak|star=1}} when a fight broke out at the bar between the criminals [[Ponda Baba]] and [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. During the fight, the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] was thrown into the table beside Kardue'sai'Malloc and his companions. ===Labria and Long Snoot=== {{Quote|Bad news, Long Snoot?''"
"''I need a job. Something quick. Today.''"
"''Do you know Derrida, the Ketton? She needs a number two for a job. Tonight.|Kardue'sai'Malloc and Garindan ezz Zavor|audio=Labria-Zavor-Derrida-FACPOV.flac|}} [[File:Ibegon-Labria-Ketwol-ANH.png|thumb|left|300px|alt|Kardue'sai'Malloc sits shrouded in shadow in the background with Dice Ibegon and Ketwol in the foreground facing each other.|Kardue'sai'Malloc sat with Dice Ibegon (left) and Ketwol (right) at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]] Kardue'sai'Malloc was still in the cantina when Zavor later returned for another drink, and while the Kubaz waited to receive [[Currency|payment]] on a job he had completed, the pair discussed the cantina house [[band]] [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. The Devaronian complimented the band, but the Kubaz criticized them for lacking in higher musical tones, prompting Kardue'sai'Malloc to retort that Zavor knew nothing of music. When the Kubaz learned he would not be getting paid, his snout deflated, and Kardue'sai'Malloc asked if something was wrong. Zavor told the Devaroninan that he needed a quick job that [[Standard day|day]], and so, with renewed interest in the Kubaz, Kardue'sai'Malloc told him that the [[Ketton]] [[Derrida]] needed a number two for an [[assassin]]ation that [[Local day|night]]. When the Kubaz questioned why Kardue'sai'Malloc had not taken the job himself, the Devaronian laughed and told him it was too much work, but when Zavor slid him half a [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]], Kardue'sai'Malloc explained that no one else would take it because it involved going against the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Zavor accepted the job and Kardue'sai'Malloc messaged Derrida from his [[datapad]], informing the Kubaz that she would send him coordinates. He then questioned Zavor on the various rumors surrounding the Kubaz, chuckling and returning the half credit for an answer when Zavor gestured for it. The Kubaz then simply told Kardue'sai'Malloc that he was a long way from [[Kubindi|home]] and left. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Why don't you take it, then?''"
"''Too much work.''"
"''Why has no one else taken the job?''"
"''It's against the Alliance. No one likes taking sides. The humans don't, I mean. One master is much the same as another.|Garindan ezz Zavor and Kardue'sai'Malloc|audio=Zavor-Labria-AgainstAlliance-FACPOV.flac|}} [[File:LabriaCrowd-Activity.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=The Ithorian Momaw Nadon, the human Luke Skywalker, Kardue'sai'Malloc, the Duros Ohwun De Maal, and the Aqualish Ponda Baba stand along a bar each with a drink infront of them.|Kardue'sai'Malloc was a regular at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]] Kardue'sai'Malloc was a wily,''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' cruel, and vicious individual. He considered one master much the same as the other when taking jobs and was not concerned about siding with the Empire or Alliance during the war but believed that it was something that [[human]]s specifically took issue with. However, he considered working with Derrida on an Imperial assassination to be too much work, but passed along information on the job to Zavor, only divulging its controversial nature when paid half a credit. Once Zavor accepted the job, Kardue'sai'Malloc looked at the spy as though seeing him for the first time and having heard many rumors about the Kubaz, the Devaronian was willing to return the half credit to learn what Zavor considered to be the truth. Kardue'sai'Malloc considered the music of [[Figrin D'an]] and the Modal Nodes to be good and criticized Zavor's knowledge when the Kubaz claimed that the band's performance was lacking in higher tones. Zavor did not believe that the Devaronian could understand him or read even a fraction of any body language he expressed, although he was able to note the Kubaz's reaction to learning that he had not been paid. When thinking, Kardue'sai'Malloc audibly slid his pointed, yellowing [[Tooth|teeth]] in and out of place. He had [[Color|red]] skin and brown [[eye]]s. ==Skills and abilities== Kardue'sai'Malloc had average speed, strength, intelligence, and fighting abilities but had below average [[diplomat]]ic skills and was a terrible spy. He was not [[Force-sensitive]]. In combat he used his large horns against foes when it was necessary, which it often was while he was on the run. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Tell her I'll do it.''"
"''It's done. She'll send you coordinates.|Garindan ezz Zavor and Kardue'sai'Malloc talk as Kardue'sai'Malloc sends a message to Derrida with his datapad|audio=Zavor-Labria-ItsDone-FACPOV.flac|}} At the cantina, Kardue'sai'Malloc wore an [[Clothing|outfit]] befitting a disguised man of his distinguished station. It included a dark gray [[Scarf|cravat]], a navy-blue shirt, silver [[gauntlet]]s, a black vest, a black [[Cloak|cape]], black pants, black [[boot]]s, and a black [[belt]] with a [[blaster]] [[holster]]. He also had black [[glove]]s, but did not wear them. The Devaronian used a datapad and [[weapon]]s including a [[DL-18 blaster pistol]] and a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].''[[Star Wars: A New Hope: Activity Book]]'' ==Behind the scenes== ===Filming and costume=== [[File:Labria-Mask.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Front and side views of the Kardue'sai'Malloc mask on a stand.|Kardue'sai'Malloc's mask was created by Rick Baker.]] Kardue'sai'Malloc was portrayed by [[Penny McCarthy]]{{SW|url=news/bobby-moynihan-star-wars-celebration-chicago|text=Resistance's Bobby Moynihan headed to ''Star Wars'' Celebration Chicago}} in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|Star Wars: Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which was released on [[May 25]], [[1977]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' The character's shots were filmed during additional photography{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}} in post-production where supplemental footage was created for the cantina sequence{{InsiderCite|126|The Beastmaster!}} on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]] and [[January 25|25]], 1977.''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]'' Makeup artist [[Rick Baker]] created the latex mask used for Kardue'sai'Malloc for an early 1970s [[Wikipedia:John Landis|John Landis]] film pitch that was never released called "I was a Teenage Vampire," and it was then used in "The Thing in the Attic," a Halloween show by [[Wikipedia:Bob Burns III|Bob Burns]] in [[1974]].{{WebCite|url=http://www.tomspinadesigns.com/restoration/star-wars-props/star-wars-devil-cantina-alien-mask-restoration|text=Preserving the original Rick Baker Star Wars Devil cantina alien mask|work=[http://www.tomspinadesigns.com tomspinadesigns.com]|archivedate=20221208162903}} By the time it was used in ''[[Star Wars]]'', the mask had been altered by shortening the horns and removing a beard.{{YouTube|video=d1AAd1tsPds|text=Star Wars: A New Hope – Cantina Archeology Part 2: Behind The Scenes of the Mos Eisley Cantina – US|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}} The character was called "Louie," "the Devil," and "Devil Guy" on set. The mask was later gifted to Burns and his wife, Kathy Burns, who then had it partially restored for display by [[Tom Spina]] Designs, as it had become distorted. ===Name and non-canon=== In the current ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], both of the character's names were first used in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'', which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}} the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}} [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character was first identified as just "[[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Labria]]" in ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'', a [[1989]] supplement written by [[Grant S. Boucher]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' The name "Kardue'sai'Malloc" was then introduced in "[[Empire Blues: The Devaronian's Tale]]," a short story written by [[Daniel Keys Moran]] and published in the [[1995]] anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''.{{StoryCite|story=Empire Blues: The Devaronian's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}} [[File:HomerCantina.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Kardue'sai'Malloc leans on the bar of the Mos Eisley Cantina facing another alien patron with six eye stalks. Homer Simpson leans against the bar drinking in the foreground with the Rodian Greedo next to him.|Kardue'sai'Malloc appeared alongside Homer Simpson in the ''Simpsons'' short ''Maggie Simpson in "The Force Awakens From Its Nap."'']] Kardue'sai'Malloc appears in [[The Force Awakens From Its Nap|''Maggie Simpson in "The Force Awakens From Its Nap"'']], a non-canon ''[[w:c:simpsons:The Simpsons|The Simpsons]]'' short"[[The Force Awakens From Its Nap]]" released on [[May 4]], [[2021]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1389233973486768136|[[Star Wars]]|quote=In a daycare far, far away… but still in Springfield. Maggie Simpson in "The Force Awakens From Its Nap" is streaming tomorrow, May the 4th on #DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20210503150310}} In the short, the Devaronian can be seen during the credits talking to another patron next to [[Homer Simpson]] at the bar of the Mos Eisley cantina. The character also appeared in "[[Tatooine Rhapsody]]," an ambiguously canon short film in the ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]'' series{{Visions|Tatooine Rhapsody}} released on [[September 22]], 2021.{{SWYouTube|b9Gr9gKFxpE|STAR WARS: VISIONS | SPECIAL LOOK | DISNEY+|sw_url=video/special-look-star-wars-visions}} In the film, the Devaronian is shown at the bar in the Mos Eisley cantina while other patrons watch a performance by the band [[Star Waver]] on handheld [[viewscreen]]s. Kardue'sai'Malloc is also shown listening to the Modal Nodes play at the cantina when rebel agent [[Kori Zaran]] passes through while trying to reach [[Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth]] in the [[2023]] non-canon [[LEGO]] book ''[[LEGO Star Wars Galaxy Mission]]'', which was written by [[Julia March]] with LEGO models by [[Rod Gillies]].''[[LEGO Star Wars Galaxy Mission]]'' In the non-canon animated short "[[Jabba All The Way]]," which was released as part of the ''[[LEGO STAR WARS: Celebrate the Season]]'' series on [[December 13]], [[2024]], the Devaronian can briefly be seen standing at the bar in the cantina in the short's opening shot.{{CelebrateTheSeason|Jabba All The Way}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Kardue'sai'Malloc|imagecat=Images of Kardue'sai'Malloc}} *[[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]] *''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Bounty Hunt]]'' *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: A New Hope Cinestory Comic]]'' *{{StoryCite|story=The Secrets of Long Snoot|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *"[[The Force Awakens From Its Nap]]" *{{Visions|Tatooine Rhapsody}} *{{CelebrateTheSeason|Jabba All The Way}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: A New Hope: Activity Book]]'' {{Po}} *{{SWCT|set=Locations -
